sources.title: Summary of NATO's revised Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy
sources.snippet: The Alliance and like-minded NATO partners could co-operate on adoption methods; developing innovation ecosystems and mitigating AI-related risks. Joint AI research and development initiatives among Allies, NATO partner countries, Allied industry, research and academia helps tap into collective expertise and resources.
